comment: Certification targets (docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-03-rules-engine-lasagna-design.md section 11.3 C5/C7/C8). formats are in declared-target order: the impact table ranks primitives by the cards they block in each format in this order. A format lists its sets explicitly (sets) or by XMage set type and release date (set_types, from). A tournament format excludes non_tournament_set_types; a card is non-tournament when its front face carries a non_tournament_card_types type, every set printing it is a non-tournament set type, or it carries a non_tournament_primitives primitive. A primitive every one of whose blocked cards is non-tournament is excluded from the All target.
